name: Enchantments and auras
description: White and green cards that put auras on your own creatures, draw a card when you cast enchantments, tell stories as sagas and keep your favourite creature safe.

cards.name: Halvene, Warden of Threads
cards.rule_text:
Enchanted creatures you control get +1/+1 and have ward {1}.
Whenever an Aura you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, you may return that card to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Verith, Grove of Stories
cards.rule_text:
Whenever another enchantment you control enters, you gain 1 life and scry 1.
Whenever you cast your second enchantment spell each turn, draw two cards.
cards.flavor_text: She remembers every story ever told beneath her leaves.

cards.name: Mossy Shrine Dryad
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
Whenever another enchantment you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Lanternmoss Keeper
cards.rule_text: Whenever another enchantment you control enters, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land or enchantment card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Loom of Small Blessings
cards.rule_text:
Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you gain 1 life.
At the beginning of your end step, if you've cast two or more enchantment spells this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Petal Augury
cards.rule_text:
When CARDNAME enters, scry 2.
{2}{G}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: Read the petals before they fall.

cards.name: Gather the Wards
cards.rule_text: Look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal up to two enchantment cards from among them and put them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Gift of the Open Hand
cards.rule_text:
Enchant creature you control
When CARDNAME enters, draw a card.
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has vigilance.

cards.name: Thornbark Mantle
cards.rule_text:
Enchant creature you control
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has trample.
cards.flavor_text: The forest lends its armour to those who walk gently.

cards.name: Wings of the Dawn Choir
cards.rule_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has flying and lifelink.

cards.name: Veil of Quiet Vows
cards.rule_text:
Flash
Enchant creature you control
Enchanted creature has hexproof and indestructible.
cards.flavor_text: A promise kept is the strongest shield.

cards.name: Starhorn Unicorn
cards.rule_text:
Bestow {4}{W} (If you cast this card for its bestow cost, it's an Aura spell with enchant creature. It becomes a creature again if it's not attached.)
Lifelink
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has lifelink.

cards.name: Song of the First Seed
cards.rule_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
II — Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures you control.
III — Return up to one target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Chronicle of the Long Watch
cards.rule_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
II — Return up to one target enchantment card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
III — Creatures you control get +1/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Gentle Banishment
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, exile target creature or enchantment an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less until CARDNAME leaves the battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: Not gone. Just elsewhere, for a while.

cards.name: Steadfast Weave
cards.rule_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
• Enchantments you control gain indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Crown of the Endless Spring
cards.rule_text:
Enchant creature you control
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each enchantment you control and has trample and hexproof.

cards.name: Ancient of the Woven Grove
cards.rule_text:
Vigilance, trample
CARDNAME gets +1/+1 for each enchantment you control.
cards.flavor_text: Every ribbon tied to its branches makes it stand a little taller.

cards.name: Shrine of Hanging Charms
cards.rule_text:
CARDNAME enters tapped.
{T}: Add {G} or {W}.
{4}, {T}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: Return target enchantment card from your graveyard to your hand.
